dated 27th July, 2002.‑‑‑The following Order promulgated
by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
General Clauses (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of new section 20A, Act X of 1897

GENERAL CLAUSES
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the General Clauses Act, 1897
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 27th July, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 27th July, 2002.‑‑‑The following Order promulgated
by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
2. Insertion of new section
20A, Act X of 1897.‑‑‑In the General Clauses Act, 1897,
(X of 1897), after section 20, the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:‑‑
"20A. Rules and Order,
etc., to be published.‑‑‑All rules, Orders, regulations
and circulars having the effect of law made or issued under any enactment shall
be published in the Official Gazette."
